environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-13900HX, 8 performance cores plus 16 efficiency cores, 32 logical CPUs
environment.configuration: 2D Release -O2, C++23, PCH ON, LTO OFF, compiler cache OFF, mold linker
environment.source: Linux persistent worktree; original /tmp aliases preserved for build paths
environment.host_activity: Other user builds were active during parts of this session. Sampled compiler counts and whole-host memory/swap observations are retained; no CPU, thermal or I/O isolation is claimed.

scope.included: Rebuild all Kin/runtime and game objects/PCHs needed by hex_demo, archive creation and final game link.
scope.prebuilt: Third-party libraries, generated shaders/embedding and CMake configuration. No dependency downloads or third-party compilation in timed runs.
scope.method: Remove only reachable Kin/game compiler outputs within the owned build directory. Run serial trials with fixed job counts and one hardware thread from each selected performance core.
scope.comparison: Worker count and available performance cores differ; source and build configuration remain unchanged.
scope.first_eight_worker_run_note: Five unrelated benchmark source entries were disabled during this run, then restored. They are outside the hex_demo dependency graph; all reachable compile commands and the 221 timed outputs match.

baseline_worker_occupancy.interpretation: Observed task durations imply little idle-worker headroom. This is a fixed-duration scheduling bound, not a prediction under different CPU load or frequency.

four_worker_exploratory_trial.implementation: Enable CMAKE_OPTIMIZE_DEPENDENCIES for engine-directory static libraries, define scripting targets earlier, and isolate generated shader data in an object library.
four_worker_exploratory_trial.interpretation: Lua work started earlier but the complete build was slower. Concurrent compiler activity and the approximately 18% median slowdown across unchanged compile tasks prevent attributing the difference to this experiment. This pair alone did not demonstrate a saving. CMake edits were reverted for the worker-count comparison, then an equivalent change was tested in a separate eight-worker comparison.

edit_loop.method: Three no-change builds, three comment-only edits to games/hex_demo/src/main.cpp and three to engine/src/ecs/ui2.cpp, including the resulting archive/game link. Compiler cache disabled; PCH and dependencies warm. Original bytes restored and rebuilt between cases and at completion.

memory_measurement_notes: Process-tree RSS was sampled at 0.5-second intervals. Summing RSS double-counts shared pages, including PCH mappings; it is not physical memory usage or PSS.
Host MemAvailable and swap-page changes cover all processes, including other builds. They cannot be attributed solely to the benchmark.
The first four-worker baseline had no memory/activity sampler; the remaining current runs used the same sampling code.

recommendation.scope: Use as a measured starting point on this machine. Tune worker count on other machines; this comparison does not establish GCC/MSVC compile-time gains or a one-file-edit gain from parallelism.

import argparse
import os
import datetime
import json
import pathlib
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import time

base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev')
logs=pathlib.Path('/tmp/kin-build-bench/schedule-phase')
logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
jobs=int(os.environ.get('KIN_BENCH_JOBS','4'))
assert jobs in (4,8)
affinity=(sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) if os.environ.get('KIN_BENCH_AFFINITY')=='all' else list(range(0,jobs*2,2)))
builds={('gcc','before'):base/'kin-build-time-out',('clang','before'):base/'kin-build-time-clang',
        ('gcc','after'):base/'kin-build-time-out',('clang','after'):base/'kin-build-time-clang'}
sources={'before':pathlib.Path('/tmp/kin-build-time'),'after':pathlib.Path('/tmp/kin-build-time')}

def commands(build):
    return subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-t','commands','hex_demo'],text=True).splitlines()

def warm(compiler, phase):
    build=builds[compiler,phase]
    archives=[]
    for line in commands(build):
        args=shlex.split(line)
        for i,arg in enumerate(args[:-3]):
            if args[i:i+3]==['-E','rm','-f'] and args[i+3].endswith('.a') and not pathlib.Path(args[i+3]).name.startswith('libkin_'):
                archives.append(args[i+3])
    assert len(archives)>=5,archives
    graph=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-t','graph','hex_demo'],text=True)
    labels=set(re.findall(r'\[label="([^"]+)"\]',graph))
    targets=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-t','targets','all'],text=True).splitlines()
    generated=[line.rsplit(': ',1)[0] for line in targets if line.endswith(': CUSTOM_COMMAND') and line.rsplit(': ',1)[0] in labels]
    archives.extend(generated)
    log=logs/f'warm-{compiler}-{phase}.log'
    with log.open('w') as out:
        result=subprocess.run(['ninja','-C',str(build),f'-j{jobs}',*archives],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if result.returncode:
        print(log.read_text()[-5000:],flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError('dependency warmup failed')
    print(json.dumps({'step':'dependencies-ready','compiler':compiler,'phase':phase,'archives':len(archives)}),flush=True)

def outputs(build,source):
    result=[]
    for line in commands(build):
        args=shlex.split(line)
        if '-c' not in args or '-o' not in args: continue
        inputfile=pathlib.Path(args[args.index('-c')+1])
        if not inputfile.is_absolute(): inputfile=build/inputfile
        if not inputfile.is_relative_to(source) and not inputfile.is_relative_to(build/'engine') and not inputfile.is_relative_to(build/'games'):
            continue
        output=(build/args[args.index('-o')+1]).resolve()
        assert output.is_relative_to(build.resolve()),output
        result.append(output)
    assert len(result)>200,len(result)
    return result

def memory_available():
    return next(int(line.split()[1]) for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('MemAvailable:'))

def swap_counters():
    return {key:int(value) for key,value in (line.split() for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/vmstat').read_text().splitlines()) if key in ('pswpin','pswpout')}

bench_owned_pids=set()

def external_compiler_count():
    count=0
    for procdir in pathlib.Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if not procdir.name.isdigit() or int(procdir.name) in bench_owned_pids:continue
        try:comm=(procdir/"comm").read_text().strip()
        except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):continue
        if comm in ("cc1plus","cc1","clang++","clang"):count+=1
    return count

def process_tree_rss(pid):
    bench_owned_pids.add(pid)
    rss=0;count=0
    try:
        status=pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{pid}/status').read_text()
        rss=next((int(line.split()[1]) for line in status.splitlines() if line.startswith('VmRSS:')),0)
        count=1
        children=pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{pid}/task/{pid}/children').read_text().split()
    except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):
        return rss,count
    for child in children:
        child_rss,child_count=process_tree_rss(int(child));rss+=child_rss;count+=child_count
    return rss,count

def record(compiler,phase,run):
    build=builds[compiler,phase]
    source=sources[phase]
    files=outputs(build,source)
    # Restrict removal to the Kin/game compile outputs reachable from hex_demo;
    # generated content and all third-party objects/archives stay intact.
    for output in files:
        output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    label=f'{compiler}-{phase}-j{jobs}-{run}'
    log=logs/(label+'.log')
    dry=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-n',f'-j{jobs}','hex_demo'],text=True)
    (logs/(label+'-plan.log')).write_text(dry)
    plans=dry.splitlines()
    unexpected=[line for line in plans if ('Building C' in line and '_deps/' in line)]
    assert not unexpected,unexpected[:5]
    subprocess.run(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-t','recompact'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    ninjalog=build/'.ninja_log'
    oldlines=ninjalog.read_text().splitlines() if ninjalog.exists() else []
    stats=logs/(label+'.stats.json')
    fmt='{"user_seconds":%U,"system_seconds":%S,"wall_seconds":%e,"max_child_rss_kib":%M}'
    print(json.dumps({'step':'build-start','compiler':compiler,'phase':phase,'run':run,'deleted_compile_outputs':len(files),'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}),flush=True)
    resources={'peak_process_tree_rss_kib':0,'minimum_host_mem_available_kib':memory_available(),'peak_descendant_processes':0,'sampling_interval_seconds':0.5,'external_compiler_samples':[]} 
    swap_before=swap_counters()
    with log.open('w') as out:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/time','-f',fmt,'-o',str(stats),'taskset','-c',','.join(map(str,affinity)),'ninja','-C',str(build),f'-j{jobs}','hex_demo'],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        while proc.poll() is None:
            bench_owned_pids.clear()
            rss,count=process_tree_rss(proc.pid)
            resources["external_compiler_samples"].append(external_compiler_count())
            resources['peak_process_tree_rss_kib']=max(resources['peak_process_tree_rss_kib'],rss)
            resources['peak_descendant_processes']=max(resources['peak_descendant_processes'],count)
            resources['minimum_host_mem_available_kib']=min(resources['minimum_host_mem_available_kib'],memory_available())
            time.sleep(0.5)
    resources['host_swap_page_deltas']={key:value-swap_before[key] for key,value in swap_counters().items()}
    if proc.returncode:
        print(log.read_text()[-6000:],flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError(label+' failed')
    measured=json.loads(stats.read_text())
    lines=ninjalog.read_text().splitlines()
    if len(lines)>=len(oldlines) and lines[:len(oldlines)]==oldlines:
        lines=lines[len(oldlines):]
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('Ninja log compacted; recover this run manually before proceeding')
    tasks=[]
    for line in lines:
        parts=line.split('\t')
        if len(parts)!=5: continue
        start,end,mtime,name,cmdhash=parts
        tasks.append({'output':name,'start_seconds':int(start)/1000,'end_seconds':int(end)/1000,'wall_seconds':(int(end)-int(start))/1000})
    result={'compiler':compiler,'phase':phase,'run':run,'jobs':jobs,'cpu_affinity':affinity,'removed_compile_outputs':len(files),'exit_code':0,**measured,'resources':resources,'tasks':tasks}
    (logs/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    with (logs/'results.jsonl').open('a') as out:
        out.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('tasks','resources')}),flush=True)
    # Generated files and dependencies are now warm for all following rounds.
    return result

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('action',choices=['warm','run'])
parser.add_argument('compiler',choices=['gcc','clang'])
parser.add_argument('phase',choices=['before','after'])
parser.add_argument('--run',type=int,default=0)
args=parser.parse_args()
if args.action=='warm': warm(args.compiler,args.phase)
else: record(args.compiler,args.phase,args.run)

scheduling_comparison.note: The first original run was followed by the original edit-loop checks before the first changed run. Original settings were restored for the final control. Both measured configurations use the same 221 source/PCH outputs except relocation of the generated shader data object. Dependencies and generation were prebuilt.
scheduling_comparison.interpretation: The eight-worker runs consistently shortened the final link wait by moving heavy Lua work early. The first pair had nearly equal aggregate compiler CPU time; other build activity affected the final control. The ratios are local observations rather than an isolated or cross-platform guarantee.

implementation.default_dependency_pruning: Enable CMAKE_OPTIMIZE_DEPENDENCIES in the engine directory when the caller did not explicitly select a value.
implementation.scripting_order: Declare the scripting libraries before kin_engine and attach their sources/properties in their original location. This moves them earlier among equally prioritized Ninja jobs.
implementation.shader_data: Generate and compile the same shader C++ data in a dedicated object library, which is included in the engine archive. Dependency pruning retains that small target rather than the entire engine archive.
implementation.unchanged: C++ source/headers, compiler optimization/safety flags, public APIs, dependency versions and preset job counts are preserved. Common compiler commands match after normalizing the private embedding include path. The generated data object no longer uses the full engine PCH.

limits: Full runtime rebuilds exclude third-party compilation, downloads, initial CMake configuration and shader generation.
Two runs per configuration support the scheduling comparison; three per worker count support the capacity comparison. The original eight-worker final control is additionally retained.
CPU affinity differs between the four/eight-worker capacity trials; the scheduling comparison uses identical affinity and concurrency. Normal OS scheduling can select different cores.
Other user builds, thermals, CPU frequency and background I/O were not isolated. Unchanged compile controls and activity counts show host variation.

3D validation covers shader generation and the new data object only; minimal optional-feature validation covers CMake generation only, and LTO validation covers the new object only. Windows/MSVC and full 3D runtime testing were not run.
